verdict.rationale: Capacities exposes a documented REST API with a verified live OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Bearer/OAuth authentication, plus an official hosted MCP server with live OAuth-gated endpoints — solid ground for building integrations. However, no dedicated client SDKs (e.g. Python/JS libraries) are evidenced, only the raw REST API and MCP protocol spec. Missing for 10: language-specific official SDK packages, code samples/quickstarts beyond raw API docs.
